description:
WITH NO UPWARD CHAIN. This well-presented first floor apartment is ideally located within a popular residential area, making it a perfect opportunity for first-time buyers or buy-to-let investors. Ready to move straight into, the property offers convenient access to the City Centre, along with excellent transport links and commuter routes.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance hall leading to a spacious and unusually shaped lounge/dining room, a fitted kitchen, and two generously sized double bedrooms, with the master benefiting from a useful vanity dressing room/walk in wardrobe. There is also a bathroom and a separate WC, providing practical living arrangements.

Additional features include UPVC double glazing, electric heating, and ample resident parking. The vendor has also indicated that certain goods and furnishings may be included in the sale, subject to agreement.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate what this property has to offer.
keyFeatures: Well-presented first floor apartment in a popular residential location
Ready to move straight into with no work required
Ideal for first-time buyers or buy-to-let investors

Bathroom plus separate WC for added convenience
UPVC double glazing, electric heating, and ample resident parking
